notes: Introduced-in-House (IH) text audited, 2865 chars, no referencedSources. Analysis is highly faithful: every figure (minimum five airports, two-year period, one-year briefing), every named entity (TSA Administrator, three briefing committees, APA/CRA/PRA carve-outs), and both direction cues ('shall' not 'may'; two-year sunset) verify verbatim against source. Zero material issues, zero omissions of material provisions. Minor notes only: 'test' vs source 'implement'; 'permissive' vs the mandatory (b) chapeau; 'to volunteer' / 'accompanying family' embellishments in gaps not in source; underreported groups both title-5 chapters under 'APA'; 'Cleared the House' + '2 cosponsors' are structural metadata (votes[]/Congress.gov), not IH-text facts. featured_quotes (CR quote, 30-0 committee vote) not decomposed: no Congressional Record source file available and it is a verbatim quotation outside the task's prose-field list.
